source: Perplexity Runde 2 — P07, P16, P17, P18 (fôr, stiftelser, insektindustri)
description: New actors identified in Runde 2 research: insect protein, alternative protein, foundations, feed producers

actors.name: Volare
actors.description: BSF insect protein producer, commercial plant in Hyvinkaa, Volare-01 under construction in Pori, offtake with Skretting.

actors.name: ENORM BioFactory
actors.description: BSF factory in Flemming, planned 11000 t/yr, bankrupt Oct 2025 after environmental/financial issues.

actors.name: Protix
actors.description: Commercial-scale BSF producer, global market leader for European aquafeed sector.

actors.name: InnovaFeed
actors.description: Industrial BSF co-located with starch plants, partner in Norwegian Millennial Salmon project.

actors.name: Pronofa
actors.description: Norwegian BSF pilot plant from Q1 2022.

actors.name: InvertaPro
actors.description: Early-stage Norwegian startup: insect-based fish feed from organic waste.

actors.name: Norinsect
actors.description: Small-scale Norwegian BSF producing protein for feed and organic fertilizer.

actors.name: Entomass
actors.description: Danish BSF and mealworm company, feed/food B2B.

actors.name: Insectum
actors.description: Danish BSF/mealworm for feed and food.

actors.name: Enifer
actors.description: PEKILO mycoprotein, building 3000 t/yr factory in Kirkkonummi from industrial side streams.

actors.name: Mycorena
actors.description: Mycoprotein (Promyc), bankrupt July 2024, assets acquired by Belgian Naplasol.

actors.name: Calysta
actors.description: Methanotroph gas fermentation, FeedKind SCP approved in EU as fishmeal replacement.

actors.name: MicroHarvest
actors.description: Bacterial SCP via rapid fermentation, building modular pilot plants.

actors.name: Nordic SeaFarm
actors.description: Macroalgae cultivator on Sweden's west coast for food, bioplastics and feed research.

actors.name: Seaweed Solutions
actors.description: Norwegian macroalgae producer in Trondelag for feed and food.

actors.name: Ocean Rainforest
actors.description: Offshore macroalgae producer on Faroe Islands for feed and food.

actors.name: Kaffe Bueno
actors.description: Biorefinery for spent coffee grounds, EIC-funded, 500-1500 t/yr capacity.

actors.name: Axfoundation
actors.description: Framtidens foder program with SLU and 25 partners for alternative feed.

actors.name: Mistra
actors.description: Mistra Food Futures 2020-2029 for food system transformation.

actors.name: EAT Foundation
actors.description: Behind EAT-Lancet Commission, announced wind-down in 2026.

actors.name: Ferd Sosiale Entreprenorer
actors.description: Impact investor in sustainable food, marine proteins, regenerative agriculture.

actors.name: Kavlifondet
actors.description: Owns Kavli Group, funding food waste projects incl. 40000 free meals/month.

actors.name: Sitra
actors.description: Finnish future fund, circular economy program with regional food system pilots.

actors.name: Felleskjopet Forutvikling
actors.description: Norwegian coop feed development arm working on alternative feed ingredients.

actors.name: Borregaard
actors.description: Norwegian biorefinery, relevant to wood-based yeast SCP for aquafeed.

actors.name: Alltech Fennoaqua
actors.description: Finnish aquafeed company, partner with Volare on 150-tonne insect-fed trout pilot.
